## Compatible Games

- **Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories** (`0x4F32A11F`, `0xB3AD1EA4`)
- **Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories** (`0x7EA439F5`)
- **True Crime New York City** (`0x42A9C4EC`, `0x7A9D67B8`, `0x77B4F13C`, `0xB1AC3BEB`)

## Installation

1. Download and install [PCSX2-Fork-With-Plugins](https://github.com/ASI-Factory/PCSX2-Fork-With-Plugins/releases/tag/latest).
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for PCSX2F x64](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/pcsx2f/PCSX2F.XboxRainDroplets64.zip) and unpack the content of the archive to the PCSX2F root directory, where the exe is located.
3. Launch a compatible game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- All rendering backends are compatible (Direct3D 11, Direct3D 12, OpenGL, Vulkan).
- The drops are drawn in the middle of the frame the emulator builds, so the HUD of the game stays on top of them.
- The ini is watched while the game runs, so its settings can be changed and tested without restarting.
